description: This file defines a static class 'Slug' with a method to generate URL-friendly slugs from input strings by removing invalid characters, normalizing spaces, and trimming the string to a maximum length.

classes.name: Slug
classes.description: A static class providing a method to generate URL slugs from input strings, including regex-based processing.

methods.name: GenerateSlug
methods.description: Transforms an input string into a URL slug by lowering case, removing invalid characters, consolidating spaces, trimming length, and replacing spaces with hyphens.
